cohort: 154 pregnant women undergoing caesarean section in Somalia
finding: The incidence of PDPH was lower in women who received spinal anaesthesia with a 26G Quincke spinal needle compared to those who received a 25G needle.
mod_finding: The incidence of PDPH was lower in women who received spinal anaesthesia with a 26G Quincke spinal needle compared to those who received a 25G needle.
